Salt Basin Agent API Pricing Model
Compare value-based API pricing, cost floor, margin targets, and advisory deposits across multiple client scenarios.

The recommended API call price is the greater of value-based price after volume discount and the margin-protected price floor. This keeps value as the anchor while preventing underpriced enterprise workloads.
Recommended starting targets: 20%-30% Salt Basin attribution share, 65%-80% target gross margin, and 60%-85% confidence factor depending on evidence quality and implementation risk.
